MorphoVault_kpkEURC_V1.$comment: kpk EURC vault (MetaMorpho ERC4626). Superseded by MorphoVaultsMeta (ADR 0010); vault still queried via instances.

ERC4626Wrap_RWIV.$comment: DISABLED — superseded by the RWIV custom price feed (RWIV_CustomPriceFeed). RWIV is now a registered priced asset (assets-and-price-feeds/1.json), and registerAsset auto-adds it to the ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter inclusion list, so the wallet adapter already reports the direct RWIV holding at RWIV/USD (same convertToAssets value this wrap produced as USDC). Keeping this wrap enabled would DOUBLE-COUNT the Nexus Safe's ~$250k direct RWIV. The price feed was required anyway so UniswapV3Pools can value the USDC/RWIV LP (pool 0x764D5075). See PR feat/rwiv-price-feed-univ3.

EtherFiWithdrawalQueue.$comment: ether.fi withdrawal-queue cache adapter (ADR 0014). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds tokenIds.

NexusMutualStakingPools.$comment: Nexus Mutual staking pools assisted adapter (agent-fed; ADR 0015). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports the account's staked NXM (Staking + Rewards) per StakingNFT position (positionId=abi.encode(stakingPoolAddress); the StakingNFT id is a display-only label), valued live on-chain from agent-submitted tokenIds (ownership re-verified per read). Reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds tokenIds.

StakeWiseV3ExitQueue.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue cache adapter (ADR 0014). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples.

UniswapV3Pools.$comment: Uniswap V3 pools assisted adapter (agent-fed NFT tokenId cache; ADR 0015). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports the account's Uniswap V3 LP (Supplied liquidity + Fees) per NFT position (positionId=abi.encode(npm,tokenId)), valued live on-chain (oracle-reconstructed price, not slot0) from agent-submitted tokenIds with ownerOf re-verified per read. Reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds tokenIds.
